name: omp-web
description: Run and operate omp agents on a remote server through a browser UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "bun run --cwd server dev" "bun run --cwd web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd web build && bun run --cwd server build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd shared typecheck && bun run --cwd server typecheck && bun run --cwd web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd server test && bun run --cwd web test
